description: Japanese Cognitive Atlas Source Library. Every entry here is a citable, checkable source that a knowledgePosition.evidence[] entry in index.html may point at by id. This file exists to make the Data Integrity Principle enforceable in practice: a node may only claim 'verified' if it names a source id that actually appears here, with a real official_url or a named, findable publication. Never add a source you have not at least corroborated (see verification_method on each entry) — an empty or thin Source Library is more honest than a padded one.
